Overall, I highly recommend both Dr. Priyesh Sampat and MM Hospital to anyone in need of medical care. Thank you for the excellent treatment and support.

The hospital is equipped with essential facilities like ICU, operation theatres, CT scan, pathology lab, and in-house pharmacy, making it convenient for patients to get complete treatment under one roof.

featured_reviews.name: VD S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jayesh Mehta - Age 63 years

I cannot thank the team here enough for the incredible care they provided to my father. From the clean, spacious rooms to the remarkably hospitable staff, we felt well taken care of.

I want to specifically thank RN Tejaswini Patil on the 10th floor. Her kindness and support went above and beyond; she treated my father like her own family.

We also had a great experience with Dr. Bhadresh Dedhia, who was incredibly helpful in keeping my father comfortable and explained every necessary procedure and every diagnosis to us with utmost patience everyday.
Dr. Jatin Kothari, who is truly one of the best nephrologists we have encountered also meticulously supervised my fathers care while he was admitted. Always quick to respond to our queries, even when he is out of office and has a GREAT team supporting my father’s renal procedures.
Dr Kayan Sisodia supervised my dad’s cardiac procedures and had also earlier performed my dad’s angiography a few years ago. He is one of the finest cardiac doctors and above that, an extremely humble human being. He makes you feel completely at ease the minute you speak to him.

Although the admin and TPA desk seemed a bit understaffed and could be improved, it did not take away from the phenomenal medical treatment my father received. Namrata from the TPA department ensured all my queries were taken care of. Grateful to the whole team for everything.

featured_reviews.name: Nihar Kavdia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Admission process was fast, completed in around half an hour.

Rooms are good, clean and spacious.
Staff is helpful. They support you in every need and come very fast.

Billing at reception is pathetic, they include charges and not even explain.

Discharge takes around 4-7 hours, your entire day will get into getting discharged.

TPA support is pathetic, they didn't upload sufficient documents and later a lot many items were rejected. This was the most pathetic thing

Cafeteria is like airport lounge, very clean, hygiene, having comfortable sofas and huge TV screens. Food was ok, we tried pizza it was too sweet.

featured_reviews.name: Armaity Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was our privilege to be under the care of Dr. Shiraz Vajifdar at P. D. Hinduja Hospital & Medical Research Centre Mumbai. My daughter was admitted under her supervision for four days and throughout this period, Dr. Shiraz guided us with great compassion, patience and professionalism. She provided excellent treatment, explained everything clearly and gave us constant reassurance and support. We are truly grateful for her expertise and the personal attention she gave to my daughter.

We would also like to sincerely appreciate the entire team on the 8th floor of the Gynaecology Department. The reception team, nursing staff, dietician team and housekeeping staff have been extremely caring, attentive and supportive. They were always prompt, polite and ready to help, making our stay comfortable and stress-free. Heartfelt thanks to everyone for their dedication and kindness 💕

featured_reviews.name: Lavanya Anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a small day procedure that took me to Hinduja Khar & I must say I came out of the whole experience feeling like I wasn't a patient but a client of the hospital.

The hospital is efficient, clean & extremely easy to navigate but it's the staff that makes the place world class. Everyone from the team that took care of admissions, the day charge staff, the post surgery staff to the discharge staff were kind, gentle, courteous & efficient. They understand that everyone who comes to a hospital is stressed but they all made me feel so at ease that  I felt completely at ease & confident that the staff was right with me every step of the way.

I especially want to highlight the amazing day care staff- Vidya, Namrat, Aarti, Swapnil & Krutika. Dr. Sofiya who took all my readings and the helps- Sakshi & Meenakshi Maushi who ensured they were around when I needed anything . The anaesthesiologists  - Dr. Christine & Dr. Shubam were so gentle & careful with the whole administration that I think I recovered faster due to that.

Its odd to recommend a hospital but I would highly recommend PD Hinduja Khar for their attention to detail & patient care. Oh, Also, the food in the day care unit was incredible. Another added bonus I say.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Sarda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience at P. D. Hinduja Hospital was truly excellent. The entire hospital management is extremely organized and efficient, making every process smooth and hassle-free for both patients and families. The doctors are highly skilled, compassionate, and take the time to explain everything with patience and care.

A heartfelt appreciation for the nursing staff - Meena shirsat, Teju Patil & Aanchal who were attentive, kind, and incredibly supportive throughout. Their professionalism and empathy made a difficult time much more comfortable and reassuring.

The hospital maintains exceptional standards of cleanliness and hygiene, and the overall environment feels calm, safe, and well-managed. The amenities and support services for patients and family members are also very thoughtful and comfortable.

What stands out most is the genuine care and coordination across every department. From admission to discharge, the entire experience reflected excellence, compassion, and professionalism. Deep gratitude to the entire team at P. D. Hinduja Hospital for their outstanding service and dedication.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Dalmia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Heartfelt Note of Gratitude

To the Management and Staff of Khar PD Hinduja Hospital,

Dr. B.K. Mishra, Dr. Abhijit Wada, and the entire Neurosurgery Team,

We would like to express our deepest gratitude and appreciation for the exceptional care, expertise, and compassion extended to us throughout this journey.

Under the leadership of Dr. B.K. Mishra and with the support of Dr. Abhijit Wada and the entire medical team, a complex neurosurgery was carried out successfully. Your skill, confidence, and dedication gave us strength during one of the most challenging times of our lives. We are truly thankful for the excellent outcome and for the reassurance you provided every step of the way.

A very special thank you to Head Nurse Marina and the wonderful nursing team — Pranali, Drisya, Vedanti, Pooja, Kavita, Shreya, and Madhavi. Your kindness, patience, professionalism, and constant words of encouragement brought immense comfort during recovery. The warmth with which you cared for us went far beyond your duties and will never be forgotten.

We would also like to extend our sincere appreciation to the Patient Care Assistants (PCA) — Maya, Sushma, and Supriya — and the Housekeeping Team — Sadhana, Suman, and Supita. Your support, attentiveness, and cheerful presence made a significant difference every day.

A particularly heartfelt thank you goes to the ICU team, especially Shweta Pasherke, Madhu, Swati, and Aelwinstel, along with every member of the ICU staff who cared for us during the most critical phase of recovery. The period immediately following surgery was emotionally and physically overwhelming, and your patience, understanding, professionalism, and extraordinary care helped us navigate those difficult moments. You managed every situation with kindness, calmness, and compassion, ensuring that both the patient and family felt supported at all times. Your dedication transformed a frightening experience into one filled with reassurance, hope, and comfort. We will always be grateful for the care and humanity you showed us.

The entire experience at Khar PD Hinduja Hospital has been truly phenomenal. Every member of the team contributed to making a challenging medical journey feel safe, supported, and hopeful. We leave with not only gratitude for a successful surgery but also with immense respect for the incredible people who made it possible.

Thank you for your dedication, compassion, and excellence in patient care. You have touched our lives in ways that words can hardly express. The success of this surgery is a testament not only to medical excellence but also to the humanity, empathy, and teamwork that define exceptional healthcare.

With heartfelt gratitude and warm regards,

The Dalmia Family
